parts.label: Oil pump housing
parts.description: Two gear pockets and illustrative inlet/outlet passages.

parts.label: Driver gear
parts.description: Driven by the engine accessory train; teeth are schematic, not an involute manufacturing profile.

parts.label: Driven gear
parts.description: Rotates opposite the driver; oil travels around the outside of the gear pair.

parts.label: Driver shaft
parts.description: Supports and drives the driver gear.

parts.label: Pump cover
parts.description: Closes the gear chambers; remove in overview to inspect the pair.

parts.label: Pressure relief housing
parts.description: Separate illustrative housing for the spring-loaded pressure relief mechanism.

parts.label: Pressure relief plunger
parts.description: Illustrative opening travel; pressure is not calculated.

parts.label: Pressure relief spring
parts.description: Biases the relief plunger toward its seat.

parts.label: Relief adjusting plug
parts.description: Shows the spring adjustment location without prescribing a pressure setting.

reference: IO-520 overhaul, Figure 4-19 and section 7-7 (permold full-flow-filter engine). Simplified pump/relief study; filter and tachometer drive omitted.
scope: Manual-based mechanism teaching study. All dimensions and operating travel are illustrative; not a maintenance procedure or pressure simulation.
